definition: Repository-derived scientific operations and actual software execution are tracked separately. Mapping is not execution evidence.

repositories.name: BLAST+
repositories.scope: Local similarity search: find planted unique matches and report strand, coordinates, and identity.
repositories.limitations: Enumerate matches in fresh sequences; check aligned residues and spans. The inspected test uses accession-backed sequences: replace those inputs. E-values and heuristic recall need a separately specified contract.

repositories.name: SAMtools
repositories.scope: Read-depth calculation with explicit flag, base-quality, deletion, and overlapping-mate rules.
repositories.limitations: Compute depth from a generated SAM/CIGAR ledger. The manual distinguishes depth from mpileup defaults, including swapped quality-option meanings; matching their defaults is not an independent check.

repositories.name: BWA
repositories.scope: Map fresh, uniquely placed reads; recover coordinates, orientation, and edit operations.
repositories.limitations: Check against planted placements and independently replay CIGARs. Include reverse-strand and unmapped cases. Repeats, clipping, secondary alignments, and MAPQ prevent a universal exact-output oracle.

repositories.name: Bowtie 2
repositories.scope: Partition paired reads into concordant and nonconcordant outputs without losing sample or mate identity.
repositories.limitations: Check every read ID and mate against a generated ledger, including deliberately discordant pairs. Upstream count-conservation tests motivate the seed but counts alone can accept swapped reads.

repositories.name: DESeq2
repositories.scope: Diagnose confounded designs, preserve biological replicates, fit a three-stage negative-binomial model and carry its directional gene selections into a frozen GO universe.
repositories.limitations: Connected GSE60450 fits and input-reading oracles share the pinned DESeq2 statistical engine. Six native cases check every fitted gene and eligible GO term; enrichment probabilities are cross-checked with SciPy and R. Shrinkage, multifactor designs, ontology simplification, broader benchmark-lineage screening and scientific review remain outside this validation.

repositories.name: STAR
repositories.scope: Reconcile barcode-level UMI and detected-gene summaries with a sparse count matrix.
repositories.limitations: Recompute per-barcode sums and nonzero features, including absent barcodes and unique/multimapping policy. The script prints discrepancies; turn them into complete failing checks. Full splice alignment additionally needs a genome index.

repositories.name: BEDTools
repositories.scope: Expand transcript blocks into exon intervals, preserving strand-aware exon numbering; compose with overlap or sequence extraction.
repositories.limitations: Use direct arithmetic on generated block starts and sizes. Check complete interval tuples and reverse-strand exon order. BED end coordinates are excluded; feature counts and overlap-pair counts differ.

repositories.name: GATK
repositories.scope: Apply a supplied variant-quality and interval-mask policy; distinguish site from allele/genotype filtering.
repositories.limitations: Evaluate predicates and interval membership independently on generated VCF records. Check FILTER labels and retained records, including missing annotations and threshold boundaries. Filtering does not establish variant-calling accuracy.

repositories.name: pysam
repositories.scope: Count eligible bases or alleles at specified loci with explicit read and base filters.
repositories.limitations: Use a generated per-read ledger and CIGAR interpreter. Inspect overlapping mates, orphans, deletions, and BAQ policy. pysam and SAMtools share underlying code; their agreement is not independent validation.

repositories.name: MAFFT
repositories.scope: Construct or repair a small multiple alignment under a specified scoring or correspondence rule.
repositories.limitations: Check residue preservation plus independently established aligned residue pairs or a small exact scoring objective; allow equivalent alignments. The supplied repository is a 2020 snapshot; its bytewise regression diffs do not establish biological optimality.

repositories.name: HMMER
repositories.scope: Extract and reconcile protein domain sequences from a supplied domain table and alignment.
repositories.limitations: Slice fresh FASTA using domain coordinates, remove alignment gaps, and compare IDs and residues. This checks domain bookkeeping; full profile-search significance requires a pinned profile, search space, and statistical reference.

repositories.name: Seurat
repositories.scope: Join single-cell features and apply prescribed library-size log normalization or row scaling.
repositories.limitations: Compute joins and log1p(count / cell total × scale) independently; check IDs, sparse zeros, and every output value. Counts, normalized data, and scaled layers are distinct; this does not grade cell-type interpretation.

repositories.name: minimap2
repositories.scope: Recover long-read alignment spans and orientation on fresh references, including split or inverted segments.
repositories.limitations: Check placements and aligned strings against generated segments; validate PAF spans and CIGAR consumption. The example explicitly emits CIGARs without soft/hard clips. Pin presets; equal-scoring placements need equivalence rules.

repositories.name: BCFtools
repositories.scope: Calculate per-alternate-allele fractions and total alternate fraction from multiallelic depth fields.
repositories.limitations: Compute AD_alt / sum(AD) and sum(AD_alt) / sum(AD) from fresh integers. Test missing fields and zero denominators. Site-level inclusion and per-sample genotype filtering need separate checks.

repositories.name: Picard
repositories.scope: Select or exclude read pairs using a manifest while retaining correct records and metadata.
repositories.limitations: Compare the full multiset of retained SAM records against a fresh ledger; check mates and counts. The upstream test constructs paired reads. Define inclusion by read name explicitly; duplicate marking would require its own tie-breaking policy.

repositories.name: Snakemake
repositories.scope: Repair sample/lane pairing and workflow dependencies; avoid accidental Cartesian products.
repositories.limitations: Derive expected input/output mappings from a fresh sample sheet and run a bounded biological step. The tests distinguish product from zip expansion. A correct file list or successful dry run alone does not verify downstream biology.

repositories.name: HTSlib
repositories.scope: Retrieve indexed regions correctly across wrapped lines, sequence descriptions, and compressed files.
repositories.limitations: Compare extracted bases and qualities to direct slicing of generated records; test absent IDs and coordinate boundaries. HTSlib also underlies SAMtools/pysam, so use an independent parser for the oracle.

repositories.name: FastQC
repositories.scope: Compute read-length distributions and apply a supplied QC policy to generated FASTQ.
repositories.limitations: Count lengths independently and reconcile report bins and totals; include empty or variable-length records. A FastQC warning is a configured heuristic, not ground truth that a biological sample is unusable.

repositories.name: Biopython
repositories.scope: Extract compound, strand-aware features and translate explicitly defined coding sequences.
repositories.limitations: Use direct slicing, complementing, exon concatenation, and a frozen codon table. Check source-record IDs, frame, and alternative genetic codes. Reject unresolved remote references under an explicit input contract.

repositories.name: Nextflow
repositories.scope: Repair sample-key grouping and lane aggregation in a small workflow.
repositories.limitations: Compare complete groups and final per-sample artifacts to a manifest-derived oracle. The tests show that incomplete groups can disappear unless remainders are handled. Make the intended missing-lane policy explicit.

repositories.name: DIAMOND
repositories.scope: Search a tiny protein database and select hits by explicit identity and coverage criteria.
repositories.limitations: Validate planted matches and alignment-derived identity/coverage; use a supplied score table for pure filtering variants. CTest compares saved outputs, while the legacy test command is a no-op at this revision. E-values and heuristic ties need separate treatment.

repositories.name: PLINK / PLINK 2
repositories.scope: Choose variants and samples by allele frequency and missingness; keep analysis-specific and global filters distinct.
repositories.limitations: Compute called-allele denominators and selected IDs from fresh genotypes. State ploidy, founder, and missing-call rules. Do not grade PCA by raw eigenvector signs or assume a PCA-only filter also changes frequency reports.

repositories.name: Scanpy
repositories.scope: Calculate per-cell counts, detected genes, and supplied gene-set fractions; aggregate raw counts by donor.
repositories.limitations: Direct sums and nonzero counts on fresh matrices, plus independent donor/cell ledgers. Compare IDs and denominators. Vary raw versus transformed layers; do not reuse benchmark PBMC fixtures.

repositories.name: MultiQC
repositories.scope: Combine sample QC reports while retaining sample identity and QC-passed/failed denominators.
repositories.limitations: Generate reports from a hidden count ledger; check every metric and sample mapping, including N/A and filename collisions. Parsing a report correctly does not validate the upstream alignment.

repositories.name: edgeR
repositories.scope: Normalize counts with explicitly supplied library sizes/factors and a declared expression filter.
repositories.limitations: Check non-log CPM = count × 1e6 / effective library size and selected genes. Specify offsets and normalization factors; zero libraries need a defined error. This short recipe does not substitute for replicate-aware differential expression.

repositories.name: limma
repositories.scope: Fit prescribed linear models and signed contrasts with correct sample IDs and covariates.
repositories.limitations: Use an independent least-squares calculation on fresh measurements; check contrast estimates, estimability, and unmoderated uncertainty. Gene-wise weights and empirical-Bayes moderation require additional method-specific references.

repositories.name: SPAdes
repositories.scope: Reconstruct a deliberately unambiguous tiny genome, or calculate assembly summaries from supplied contigs.
repositories.limitations: For reconstruction, compare full sequences modulo permitted orientation/circular rotation and check missing/extra contigs. N50 and contig-length checks alone are insufficient: the inspected smoke test checks number and length, not sequence identity.

repositories.name: IQ-TREE
repositories.scope: Validate codon-position or gene partitions and prepare correctly labeled alignment/model inputs.
repositories.limitations: One observed COX1 alignment; package reference and oracle share the inference engine. Independent complete-tree and distance measurements pass. No species-tree truth, branch-support inference, raw-likelihood ranking or Harbor portability established.

repositories.name: FastTree
repositories.scope: Compare tree bipartitions and summarize branch lengths while respecting rooting and taxon identity.
repositories.limitations: One observed COX1 alignment; package reference and oracle share the inference engine. Independent complete-tree and distance measurements pass. No species-tree truth, branch-support inference, raw-likelihood ranking or Harbor portability established.

repositories.name: RAxML
repositories.scope: Summarize branch support or lengths across a supplied set of replicate trees.
repositories.limitations: One observed COX1 alignment; package reference and oracle share the inference engine. Independent complete-tree and distance measurements pass. No species-tree truth, branch-support inference, raw-likelihood ranking or Harbor portability established.

repositories.name: cutadapt
repositories.scope: Trim declared adapters and synchronize sequence/quality strings, including partial matches and paired reads.
repositories.limitations: Generate insert-plus-adapter reads and independently compute allowed cut positions under an explicit error/overlap rule. Test unchanged reads and boundaries. Upstream tests expose deletion-versus-substitution cases; a simple substring oracle cannot grade every fuzzy match.

repositories.name: Salmon
repositories.scope: Join transcript quantification outputs to a gene map; check decoy exclusion and abundance normalization.
repositories.limitations: Use fresh supplied quantification tables for exact ID joins, sums, and TPM arithmetic. Quantifier estimates are not latent simulated molecule counts. Inspected main is Salmon 2.0 Rust; legacy 1.x indexes/options require a separate environment.

repositories.name: kallisto
repositories.scope: Construct a transcript/sample abundance matrix or repair paired-input wiring for quantification.
repositories.limitations: Independently check transcript IDs, sample columns, explicit missing-transcript policy, and TPM from supplied counts/effective lengths. The bundled workflow requests quant/BUS artifacts but does not itself establish quantification accuracy.

repositories.name: StringTie
repositories.scope: Convert annotated transcript coverage into transcript/gene count estimates with correct exon lengths and sample joins.
repositories.limitations: Independently compute inclusive GTF exon lengths and ceil(coverage × length / read length), then aggregate by gene. Check annotation consistency. These are estimated counts; they are not exact observed molecule counts.

repositories.name: fastp
repositories.scope: Apply explicit quality, N-content, length, and complexity filters to fresh FASTQ.
repositories.limitations: Compute per-read predicates and retained IDs independently, preserving paired-read policy. Check strict versus inclusive boundaries and filter ordering. Automatic adapter detection adds ambiguity, so use declared adapters for exact trimming tasks.

repositories.name: SRA Toolkit
repositories.scope: Export biological reads from a small staged SRA fixture with correct paired and orphan outputs.
repositories.limitations: Compare IDs, sequences, qualities, and mate assignment to an independently authored spot/read ledger. Upstream fastq-dump/fasterq-dump agreement is only a cross-check. Stage the fixture locally; live accession downloads add network, provenance, and setup cost.

repositories.name: deepTools
repositories.scope: Count reads/fragments in genomic bins under a declared extension and duplicate policy.
repositories.limitations: Use direct interval arithmetic from a generated alignment ledger and check every bin, including zero bins. Separate read counts, covered bases, and normalization denominators; matching a heatmap image is unnecessary.

repositories.name: VCFtools
repositories.scope: Recalculate AC/AN and genotype QC after selecting samples from a VCF.
repositories.limitations: Count called alleles directly, including multiallelic and partially missing genotypes under explicit rules. Check retained sample IDs and header cardinalities; a fixed two-alleles-per-sample denominator fails missing and haploid cases.

repositories.name: SnpEff
repositories.scope: Classify coding SNVs as synonymous, missense, stop gained/lost, or start changes on fresh transcripts.
repositories.limitations: Reconstruct strand-aware codons and compare reference/alternate translation with an independent codon table. Check transcript ID and allele orientation. SnpEff impact categories do not establish pathogenicity; freeze annotation and genetic code.

repositories.name: Ensembl VEP
repositories.scope: Annotate variants against a supplied miniature FASTA/GTF, retaining per-transcript consequences.
repositories.limitations: Independently derive exon/CDS positions and codon changes; accept all requested transcripts rather than one arbitrary consequence. The source tests transcript construction and sequence explicitly. Pin assembly, transcript version, phase, and consequence vocabulary.

repositories.name: MACS2 / MACS3
repositories.scope: Build fragment pileups or call intervals above a supplied signal threshold.
repositories.limitations: Use independent interval accumulation, strand-specific shifts, scaling, and explicit merging rules. Verify full bedGraph/peak intervals. Such checks do not establish calibrated significance for the full MACS peak-calling model.

repositories.name: MMseqs2
repositories.scope: Cluster clearly separated synthetic sequence families and reconcile membership/representative FASTA files.
repositories.limitations: Check expected partition membership modulo representative choice, all IDs, and sequence preservation. State identity, coverage, and clustering mode; greedy clustering is not an all-pairs identity guarantee. Use small independently adjudicable cases.

repositories.name: MUSCLE
repositories.scope: Score or repair a small multiple alignment using known residue correspondences.
repositories.limitations: Check residue preservation and independently specified pair/column correspondence scores. The inspected regression accepts relative Q/TC thresholds on benchmark alignments; do not reuse those fixtures or treat those thresholds as universal biological truth.

repositories.name: Kraken 2
repositories.scope: Compute direct and clade-level counts from read assignments and a frozen miniature taxonomy.
repositories.limitations: Sum assignments up the tree, count paired fragments once, and check unclassified denominators. Ancestor clade counts overlap and must not be summed as disjoint abundances. Full classification additionally needs a pinned reference database.

repositories.name: BUSCO
repositories.scope: Reconcile complete single-copy, duplicated, fragmented, and missing ortholog categories.
repositories.limitations: Count unique BUSCO IDs against a supplied lineage inventory: C = S + D and N = S + D + F + M. Multiple hits for a duplicated ortholog do not create multiple orthologs. This checks summary accounting; sequence-level completeness needs frozen models and cutoffs.

repositories.name: UCSC Kent utilities
repositories.scope: Convert small genome-browser tracks while preserving coordinates, values, and chromosome identity.
repositories.limitations: Compare canonical intervals/values to independently generated tracks; include unknown and mixed chromosome aliases. TwoBit tasks can check exact sequence and masking. Match individual executables; utility-specific formats, float precision, and licenses differ.

repositories.name: GenomicRanges
repositories.scope: Translate interval conventions and distinguish hits, counts, and qualifying features, including compound features.
repositories.limitations: Enumerate all expected interval pairs directly with explicit strand and adjacency rules; compare IDs and multiplicities. GRanges uses one-based closed ranges, unlike BED. Cross-tool agreement requires a correct conversion.

repositories.name: Biostrings
repositories.scope: Translate coding sequences under declared genetic-code, initiation, ambiguity, and frame rules.
repositories.limitations: Enumerate codons using a frozen table; check exact peptides or specified errors. Tests distinguish resolvable ambiguous codons, X, initiation handling, and incomplete terminal codons. State these policies in the task.

repositories.name: pybedtools
repositories.scope: Extract strand-aware sequences or compose feature filtering with interval arithmetic in Python.
repositories.limitations: Check bases and feature IDs by direct arithmetic on fresh BED/FASTA; preserve stream contents and repeated records. The wrapper invokes BEDTools, so comparing the two is not independent verification.

repositories.name: nf-core/tools
repositories.scope: Repair a bounded pipeline configuration or module contract using a fresh sample sheet and specified biological output.
repositories.limitations: Validate schema and sample mappings, then check the small workflow output independently. Lint/schema success establishes configuration properties only; existing nf-core/rnaseq tests provide a downstream composition example.
